Subject: Vendor onboarding — tax identity evidence and PO info

Hi Lina,

Thanks for agreeing to get Vector Data set up in our procurement system. To get the PO issued and payment scheduled I need two quick items from you:

1) A completed tax form — either a signed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for foreign entities). We need the Taxpayer Identification Number spelled exactly as it appears on the form for verification.

2) Remittance details for your invoices (payee name, address for remit, and preferred ACH bank details or confirmation that you invoice via Stripe/Beam if you use a payment processor).

We usually get PO numbers out within 48 hours of receiving the signed tax form and remittance info. I attached our standard PO template in case you want to preview the fields.

Attachments: PO_template.docx (preview)

If you prefer, you can upload the W-9/W-8 to the DocuSign link below; finance will pick it up directly: DocuSign:0a1b2c3d

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if anything is unclear.

Best,
Karthik
